purpose: Project-agnostic executable product acceptance and targeted repair routing.

admission_proof.rule: RC_READY is admitted only after the controller recomputes the exact result from the proof inputs, matches roots, question IDs, evidence-cache digest, timing, and freeze state, and verifies the Auditor attestation is derived from that result.

question_rules: One question asks one observable yes-or-no proposition.
Every question ends with a question mark.
Every required evidence kind is independently present before YES_WITH_EVIDENCE.
Applicability is evaluated independently for every question; simultaneous domains are not elif branches.
Confidence scores, weighted aggregates, mostly-compliant states, and self-attested pass claims are forbidden.

slice_compiler.rule: The full library is available law. Each checkpoint compiles only questions triggered by its exact changed-surface manifest, plus reusable answers invalidated by those changes.
inputs: exact changed paths and derived surfaces
outputs: one compact proof for any root with no applicable questions
forbidden: writing one N/A essay per irrelevant question
asking a model to judge what a deterministic check can prove
emitting unchanged question results as new events
slice_compiler.granularity: One question should normally map to one coherent repair owner and outcome; neither vague quality prompts nor visual trivia are admitted.

evidence_cache.rule: Reuse an admitted answer only when its question-tree version and exact relevant hashes still match and selective invalidation did not touch the question.

scopes.SOURCE_STABLE: May survive a new build identity only while every bound relevant source hash is unchanged.
scopes.BUILD_ENVIRONMENT_BOUND: Requires the same build and environment identities in addition to unchanged relevant hashes.

evidence_cache.output: A compact plan of reused question IDs and question IDs needing new evidence.
evidence_cache.forbidden: Narrative claims, stale versions, changed relevant hashes, or untyped reuse scopes never reuse proof.

exception_contract.rule: EXCEPTION_REQUESTED never passes. AUTHORIZED_EXCEPTION passes only inside the exact grant scope and before expiry.

owner_blocker_contract.rule: An ordinary technical repair cannot be encoded as an owner boundary.

critical_freeze_contract.rule: Only an exact critical Security or human-safety finding from the bound Auditor freezes a surface. A global freeze additionally requires exact global-impact evidence.

security_baseline_policy.rule: Bootstrap records versioned security standards and project-specific overlays. The question compiler selects only applicable atomic requirements.
security_baseline_policy.forbidden: A single vague compliance question cannot replace atomic applicable requirements.

case_engine.if_not_applicable: Require applicability evidence and return NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_PROOF.
case_engine.elif_yes: Require every evidence binding and return YES_WITH_EVIDENCE.
case_engine.elif_no: Create one targeted repair for the exact failed question and continue unrelated work.
case_engine.elif_unknown: Acquire missing evidence autonomously; do not ask the owner.
case_engine.elif_exception_requested: Route to the named granting authority; do not pass.
case_engine.elif_authorized_exception: Validate scope, identity, expiry, compensating control, and re-evaluation trigger.
case_engine.elif_owner_boundary: Return one precise blocker and continue unaffected work.
case_engine.else: Fail closed and route internally to the Global Orchestrator.

exceptions.transient_tool_or_runtime_failure: Retry, use a safe fallback, or reassign; never convert failure into PASS.
exceptions.critical_security_or_safety_finding: Freeze only the affected surface immediately; freeze unrelated work only when evidence proves global impact.

role_interaction.GLOBAL_ORCHESTRATOR: Owns compiled tree state, custody, dependency order, repair routing, selective invalidation, compact status, and true owner blockers.
role_interaction.FEATURE_AGENT: Implements the intended feature and answers assigned atomic questions with evidence; fixes authorized NO outcomes without permission-seeking.
role_interaction.PLATFORM_AGENT: Repairs only the exact platform seam and returns evidence for the assigned question IDs.
role_interaction.AUDITOR: Compiles and evaluates questions independently in parallel, records only changed answers, NO, or UNKNOWN, and never becomes a serial approval queue or Product writer.
role_interaction.AUDIT_WORKER: A fresh on-demand read-only worker of the Auditor that evaluates exact question IDs for one material seam and cannot implement, redefine requirements, or grant exceptions.
role_interaction.GLOBAL_RUNTIME: Executes accepted integration, deployment, rollback, and runtime evidence actions; it does not decide Product semantics.

invalidation.rule: Invalidate directly matched questions and their dependent descendants. Preserve unrelated verified leaves.

repair_loop.first_no: Create one targeted repair for the exact question and causal root.
repair_loop.repeated_no_different_cause_or_route: Proceed only when the causal model, implementation route, evidence state, or governing assumption materially changed.
repair_loop.repeated_no_same_cause: Do not create an equivalent retry. The direct supervisor performs exactly one reframe.
post_reframe: execute one new viable in-scope route
use honest unavailable behavior when it satisfies intent
repair_loop.rule: Different wording is not material progress.

compact_status.rule: Agents exchange failing question IDs and bounded repair evidence, not compliance narration or repeated receipt inventories.

minimum_live_rc.scope: One real campaign, one cumulative root, one Feature Agent, on-demand Platform Agents, one parallel Auditor, one Global Orchestrator, and one Global Runtime.
required_demonstrations: compile project intent into atomic function questions
compile applicable design clauses into atomic design questions
compile versioned applicable security requirements into atomic security questions
route one NO to an autonomous targeted repair
route one UNKNOWN to autonomous evidence acquisition
prove one affected-surface critical freeze while unrelated work continues
prove one true owner blocker or prove none
admit only when all three roots pass
